Text

Paragraph component with size scale (renders as <p>).

Display

size — sm / base / lg

size="sm" Small body text — used for captions, footnotes, and secondary information that should be present but not dominant.
size="base" (default) Base body text — the standard reading size for paragraphs, article content, and general interface copy.
size="lg" Large body text — used for lead paragraphs, introductory content, and anywhere that reading comfort is prioritised.

Responsive size — size="sm md:base lg:lg"

size="sm md:base lg:lg" This text grows from small to base to large as the viewport widens — demonstrating the responsive size breakpoint syntax.

extra-class — additional utility classes applied to the <p> element

extra-class="font-semibold" Semibold weight — useful for lead sentences or pull-out statements inside a body section.
extra-class="italic" Italic style — suitable for editorial asides, citations, or to add typographic variety within flowing prose.
extra-class="text-aeblack-500 dark:text-aeblack-400" Muted colour override — secondary body copy that should remain readable but recede visually behind the primary content.
extra-class="font-bold underline" Multiple classes stacked — demonstrates that extra-class accepts a space-separated list of Tailwind utilities.

size × extra-class — font weight applied at each size step

size="sm" extra-class="font-semibold"Small semibold — captions and supporting labels that need emphasis without scale.
size="base" extra-class="font-semibold"Base semibold — the standard reading weight lifted to draw attention to a key sentence.
size="lg" extra-class="font-semibold"Large semibold — lead paragraphs or introductory statements that anchor a section visually.

Article flow — lg lead paragraph + base body copy + sm footnote

The UAE's digital transformation strategy positions the country as a global benchmark for government innovation, citizen-centred services, and data-driven policy. Across all federal and local entities, agencies are adopting unified platforms that reduce duplication, accelerate approvals, and give residents a single point of access to more than three thousand government services. Source: Ministry of Cabinet Affairs — UAE Government Annual Report 2024. Data reflects cumulative digital services as of Q4 2024.

Responsive size + extra-class — breakpoint scale with italic style

size="sm md:base lg:lg" extra-class="italic" This sentence is italic at every breakpoint while growing from small on mobile to large on widescreen — showing that both props compose correctly.

Colour via extra-class — primary vs muted body text at base size

size="base" (default colour)Primary body copy — inherits the default foreground colour from the surrounding context, maintaining full contrast.
size="base" extra-class="text-aeblack-500 dark:text-aeblack-400"Muted body copy — visually subordinate to the primary copy above, used for helper text or secondary descriptions.
size="base" extra-class="text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-400"Accent body copy — coloured to reinforce a brand moment or draw the eye to a key message without changing the size.

size="base" (RTL) تعتمد المنصات الرقمية الحكومية على معايير إمكانية الوصول العالمية لضمان تجربة مستخدم شاملة لجميع فئات المجتمع.

Multiple sections can be open at the same time in this mode. Toggle each independently. Application fee: AED 500. Annual renewal: AED 1,200. Expedited processing: AED 300 additional. For assistance call 800-UAE-GOV (800-823-468) or visit any service centre Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM – 3:30 PM.

size="lg" Larger font and more vertical space per item. Use in page sections or feature areas.

Residency permits are available to employment visa holders, investors, students, and dependants of UAE residents meeting the eligibility criteria. Residency permits are typically valid for 2 years and must be renewed before expiry through the digital services portal. Remote renewal is permitted for eligible categories through the GDRFA online portal with valid supporting documents.

Citizens of 47 countries are eligible for a visa on arrival. The permit is valid for 30 days and can be extended once for a further 30 days. All entry points including airports, land borders, and sea ports are valid for visa on arrival. Travellers must hold a confirmed return ticket. Travellers must submit a health declaration before arrival via the e-Gate portal. Digital submission is accepted at all points of entry.

A trade licence requires a completed application, Emirates ID, passport copy, and proof of business address in the emirate of operation. Registration with the Department of Economic Development is mandatory for all commercial activities. Processing takes 3–5 working days.

Personal government services available to residents and citizens.

Register on the government portal using your Emirates ID and a valid email address. A verification code will be sent within minutes. Upload colour scans of all required documents. Accepted formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG. Maximum file size is 5 MB per document. Review your application, confirm payment via the secure gateway, and receive your reference number immediately upon submission. Use your reference number to track real-time status updates via SMS, email, or the digital portal dashboard.

Manages the issuance and renewal of identity documents for all UAE residents and citizens. Services are available at authorised centres and online through the ICA portal. Oversees the labour market, employment standards, and work permit issuance. Employs a digital-first approach to labour regulation and Emiratisation quota enforcement. Administers VAT, excise tax, and corporate tax obligations. All registered entities must file returns and make payments through the EmaraTax portal.

Travellers must declare all goods exceeding AED 3,000 in value. Exemptions apply for personal items in accompanied baggage under the standard duty-free allowance. Certain items including narcotics, counterfeit goods, and items offensive to public morals are strictly prohibited. Restricted items require prior approval. Commercial goods must be accompanied by a commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin. Electronic pre-clearance is available via the Customs portal.

Primary care is available at government health centres across all emirates. Registration requires a valid Emirates ID or residency visa. Specialist referrals are issued by your registered primary care physician. Waiting times vary by specialty and urgent-care designation.

School placement, fees, and enrolment deadlines by emirate.

Government school enrolment for UAE nationals opens in May each year. Applications are submitted through the Ministry of Education portal. Private schools must hold a valid licence from the relevant education authority. Annual inspection reports are published on the KHDA website.

Processing Times Updated Standard applications are processed within 5 to 7 working days. Priority processing is available for an additional fee and reduces the timeline to 2 to 3 working days. Processing times may vary during public holidays. Fee Schedule AY 2025–26 Application fee: AED 500. Annual renewal: AED 1,200. Expedited processing: AED 300 additional charge. All fees are inclusive of VAT and non-refundable once the application is submitted. تحتاج إلى نموذج طلب مكتمل، ونسخة من الهوية الإماراتية، وجواز السفر، وإثبات العنوان التجاري. قد تُطلب مستندات إضافية بحسب نشاطك التجاري. تُعالج الطلبات العادية خلال 5 إلى 7 أيام عمل. تتوفر المعالجة المُعجَّلة مقابل رسوم إضافية وتُختصر المدة إلى يومين أو ثلاثة. نعم. تجديد الرخصة متاح بالكامل عبر البوابة الرقمية. ستصلك إشعارات تذكيرية قبل 60 يوماً من انتهاء الصلاحية. هذا البند معطَّل ولا يمكن توسيعه.
تُدير إصدار وثائق الهوية وتجديدها لجميع المقيمين والمواطنين في الإمارات. تتوفر الخدمات في المراكز المعتمدة وعبر بوابة ICA الإلكترونية. تُشرف على سوق العمل ومعايير التوظيف وإصدار تصاريح العمل. تعتمد نهج رقمي أولاً في تنظيم العمل وتطبيق حصص التوطين. تُدير ضريبة القيمة المضافة والضريبة الانتقائية وضريبة الشركات. يجب على جميع الجهات المسجَّلة تقديم الإقرارات والمدفوعات عبر منظومة إماراتاكس.

      Programmatic API — show() · close() · toggle() + aria-labelledby pass-through

      .show()show()
      .close()close()
      .toggle()toggle()

      Programmatic API demo

      This modal has no label prop. Its accessible name comes from aria-labelledby="modal-api-heading" pointing to the heading above — the attribute is forwarded from the host element to the inner role="dialog" div via getPassThroughAttributes().

      • The show() button calls el.show()
      • The close() button calls el.close()
      • The toggle() button calls el.toggle() — if open it closes, if closed it opens

      is-open — declarative attribute / property assignment (bypasses .show() / .close())

      setAttribute('is-open','true')Set is-open attr
      removeAttribute('is-open')Remove is-open attr
      el.isOpen = !el.isOpen (property)Toggle .isOpen prop

      Declarative is-open

      Opened via setAttribute('is-open','true') or el.isOpen = true — not .show(). The @Watch('isOpen') watcher fires the same open/close sequence as the method API.

      Drawer

      Side panel sliding in from any edge — all positions, sizes, animation, pinned and overlay modes.

      Actions

      Trigger buttons

      Right (default) Left Top Bottom Size: xs Size: sm Size: lg Size: xl Size: full No animation No overlay close Fade animation Unpinned (floating) No overlay Overlay: light Overlay: dark No scroll lock No padding

      Right Drawer

      Slides in from the right. Standard panel for settings, filters, or detail views.

      Close

      Left Drawer

      Slides in from the left — common for sidebar navigation.

      Close

      Top Drawer

      Slides down from the top — for search overlays or notification centres.

      Close

      Bottom Drawer

      Slides up from the bottom — used for action sheets on mobile.

      Close

      XS Drawer — size="xs" — 320px

      Compact strip: notifications, icon sidebars, quick-action panels.

      Close

      SM Drawer — size="sm" — 384px

      Narrow panel: filter sidebars, compact navigation.

      Close

      LG Drawer — size="lg" — 640px

      Wide panel: forms with multiple fields, data tables, step-by-step flows.

      Close

      XL Drawer — size="xl" — 800px

      Extra-wide panel: complex multi-section forms, wizards, rich detail views.

      Close

      Full Drawer — size="full" — 100vw

      Full-screen takeover: immersive workflows that need complete focus.

      Close

      No Animation — animation="none"

      Opens without slide animation — instant appearance.

      Close

      No Overlay Close

      Clicking the backdrop does not close this drawer. Must use the Close button.

      Close

      Fade Animation — animation="fade"

      Opens and closes with an opacity fade instead of a slide transition.

      Close

      Unpinned — is-pinned="false"

      Floats with a gap from the edge and rounded corners rather than being flush to the viewport.

      Close

      No Overlay — is-overlay="false"

      Drawer opens without a backdrop overlay behind it. Page content remains fully interactive.

      Close

      Overlay Opacity: light

      Backdrop uses a lighter opacity — page content behind is more visible.

      Close

      Overlay Opacity: dark

      Backdrop uses a darker opacity — drawer content stands out more strongly.

      Close

      No Scroll Lock — is-prevent-scroll="false"

      Body scrolling is NOT locked when this drawer is open. Scroll the page while the drawer is visible.

      Close

      is-padding="false"

      Content fills edge to edge — useful for image panels, custom layouts, or tightly structured UIs.

      Close

      Known CSS Bugs

      Confirmed visual defects in Shadow DOM styles — opacity compounding at disabled states

      4 Bugs

      All four defects are reproducible in the current build. Each row contrasts the buggy state against its expected baseline.

      ⚠ Bug #1 — aegov-toggle: disabled + is-checked — double opacity (wrapper 0.4 × track 0.4 = 0.16)

      Baseline: disabled + off

      BUG: disabled + on

      Expected: on (not disabled)

      Root cause: .toggle__wrapper:has(:disabled) { opacity:0.4 } AND input:disabled + .toggle__track { opacity:0.4 } both fire simultaneously → computed opacity 0.16. Fix: remove one of the two opacity rules.

      ⚠ Bug #2 — aegov-checkbox: disabled + is-checked — checked indicator barely visible

      Baseline: disabled unchecked

      BUG: disabled + checked

      Expected: checked (not disabled)

      Root cause: Parent wrapper opacity + input:disabled:checked { opacity:0.4 } compound → visual opacity ~0.16. Checkmark becomes illegible.

      ⚠ Bug #3 — aegov-radio: disabled + checked — inner dot nearly invisible

      Root cause: Same double-opacity pattern as checkbox — wrapper + inner dot both receive opacity reduction.

      ⚠ Bug #4 — aegov-range: disabled — thumb cursor stays pointer instead of not-allowed

      Enabled (correct cursor)

      BUG: Disabled (hover thumb — cursor stays pointer)

      Root cause: .range__thumb { cursor: pointer } has higher specificity than the inherited cursor: not-allowed set on the host when disabled.
